content: “War farreḥ ca ammu, Israil, ařami i ɣa tesřiwřiwed am řegnus. Maɣar tiggʷejed x AREBBI nnec am tessefseded ixef nnec. Tettexsed řmunet n ict n temɣart n farq-ccɣeř di marra inedrar n usarwet n imendi.
Andrar d tsirt n uḍiř war d asen sseccen ca u binu n jdid ad tt ixeyyeb.
Nitni war ttɣiman ca di temmurt n SIDI. Ifrayim ad dd-idweř ɣar Miṣra u nitni ad ccen min ixemjen di Accur.

Nitni war seyyben ca tiwhibin n binu i SIDI u tiɣarṣa nsen war xas areṭṭant. Ad asen iřint am weɣrum n yinni iceṭṭnen. Marra inni t iccen, ad dewřen xemjen, maɣar aɣrum nsen ad yiři i řeɛmar nsen, war dd-ittis di Taddart n SIDI.
Min ɣa teggem xenni deg ijj n wass n řɛid ittwaggen, deg wass n Řɛid n SIDI?
Maɣar, xzar, aqa nitni ttaggʷejen zi ssibbet n ureddeǧ. Miṣra ad ten issmun, Muf ad ten tenḍeř. Irezzazen ad meẓẓren di nnuqart nsen, cbarq ak-d isennanen ad iṭṭef amcan n iqiḍan nsen.

Aqa ussan n ujarreb usin-dd, aqa ussan n lɛiqab usin-dd. Nitni ad tt ssnen, inni n Israil. Anabi am yijj n abuhaři i nitni, aryaz arruḥani am yijj n bu-jnun zeg waṭṭas n řmuɛṣiyyet nnec d waṭṭas n řeɛdawet nnec.
Aɛessas n Ifrayim ittɛessas ak-d uɛawen n AREBBI inu, wah, netta, anabi ittaf ijj n řfex n unegmar di marra ibriden nnes, řeɛdawet di Taddart n AREBBI nnes.
Maɣar aqa aten ɣarqen ař iři, am deg wussan nni n Jibɛa. Netta ad iɛqeř x řmuɛṣiyyet nsen u ad ixřef ddnub nsen.”

“Necc ufiɣ Israil am uḍiř di řexřa, ẓriɣ řejdud nwem am yimenza n wartu di temẓi nsen. Nitni maca udfen ɣar Baɛl-Faɣur uca wcin ixef nsen s řefḍiḥet i netta uca nitni dewřen d nnɛawat am wenni tuɣa ttexsen.
X yinni n Ifrayim, aqa aɛuǧi nsen ad iḍu am wejḍiḍ, ad yaggʷej x wexřaq u x uɛeddis n yemmas u x tkessit n tarwa.
Waxxa nitni ssyamen iḥenjiren nsen ař ɣa mɣaren, Necc ad ten arreɣ nhřa iḥenjiren ařami war din iqqim bnadem. Maɣar uřa i nitni s tidett, uct, xmi xasen ɣa ḥeyydeɣ.
Axmi ẓriɣ Ṣur, ammu i ittwaẓẓu Ifrayim deg ict n jjihet arḍan. U řexxu ittxeṣṣa i Ifrayim ad isellem tarwa nnes i uqettař.
Ewc asen, a SIDI! Min i ɣa tewced? Ewc asen ijj n uɛeddis s weṭṭuw n iseyman d yebbac yuẓɣen.
Marra taɛeffant nsen tɛarra di Jiljal, maɣar dinni carheɣ ten x tɛeffant n tmegga nsen. Necc ad xasen aẓẓřeɣ zi Taddart inu. Ɛemmarṣ ɛad ad ten xseɣ ɛad, marra řḥukkam nsen d imɣewwɣen.
Ifrayim ittwawwet, iẓewran nsen uẓɣen, war ttirwen ɛad. Waxxa nitni ttarwen, Necc ad nɣeɣ imɛizzan n uɛeddis nsen.
AREBBI inu ad ten inḍar, maɣar nitni war ɣares ttesřin, u nitni ad dewřen ttᵉtliɛen jar řegnus.”

footnotes.text: Muf- isem wanita ixs ad yini ‘Mimfis’, tandint taqdimt aṭṭas n Miṣra. Ad tafed isem wanita di Ica. 19:13, Irm. 2:16, 44:1 d Ḥiz. 30:13, 16 d Huciya 9:6.
